source_gap_claims.behavior: A local-only Skill must explicitly declare external API/version lookup as not applicable and validate without Context7, MCP, or network access.
source_gap_claims.reason: The supplied obligations constrain Package A's own network behavior but do not require local-only Skill declarations to disable external lookup channels.
source_gap_claims.subject: Local-only Skill external-lookup declaration and offline validation

source_gap_claims.behavior: A local-only fixture without network configuration must validate successfully, while a fixture declaring local-only status together with a network/API dependency must be rejected.
source_gap_claims.reason: No supplied obligation covers the local-only fixture pass case or contradiction between local-only status and a declared network/API dependency.
source_gap_claims.subject: Local-only Skill consistency validation

source_gap_claims.behavior: A version-sensitive Skill must declare Context7-first lookup when available, official HTTPS fallback when unavailable, and records for version, source, and retrieval date.
source_gap_claims.reason: The supplied obligations contain no declaration or provenance requirements for version-sensitive external lookup.
source_gap_claims.subject: Version-sensitive lookup policy and provenance

source_gap_claims.behavior: A version-sensitive Skill must declare behavior for missing or stale information, and validation must reject missing version/source/date, HTTP fallback, arbitrary nonofficial fallback, or absent failure policy.
source_gap_claims.reason: No supplied obligation requires stale or missing-information handling or these version-lookup safety failures.
source_gap_claims.subject: Version-sensitive lookup failure handling

source_gap_claims.behavior: Static validation must not perform the declared version lookup, and historical lookup records must be treated only as syntax/provenance inputs rather than proof of current latest versions.
source_gap_claims.reason: Existing no-network constraints apply to Package A operations generally but do not establish the specific no-lookup and historical-record semantics for version-sensitive Skills.
source_gap_claims.subject: Static validation and historical lookup-record boundary

source_gap_claims.behavior: Secret-using capabilities must name the runtime credential owner, safe reference mechanism, redaction policy, and denied output locations.
source_gap_claims.reason: The supplied obligations do not require any of the four secret-capability declaration fields.
source_gap_claims.subject: Secret capability declaration

source_gap_claims.behavior: Validation must reject synthetic literal credential fields or known secret markers, a missing credential owner, or a raw secret-output policy; diagnostics must report only location and rule, with no real credential fixture and no universal secret-detection claim.
source_gap_claims.reason: No supplied obligation covers secret-marker rejection, credential-owner or output-policy checks, restricted diagnostics, prohibition of real credential fixtures, or the stated limit on detection claims.
source_gap_claims.subject: Secret handling validation and diagnostic boundary

source_gap_claims.behavior: Destructive operations must declare affected scope, required confirmation or authorization source, and recovery or irreversibility disclosure.
source_gap_claims.reason: The supplied obligations contain no destructive-operation declaration requirements.
source_gap_claims.subject: Destructive-operation safety declaration

source_gap_claims.behavior: Validation must reject missing scope, bypass flags, or confirmation derived solely from untrusted input, while accepting existing session/user authorization where the owning policy permits it without requiring redundant confirmation for every operation.
source_gap_claims.reason: No supplied obligation covers destructive-operation bypass detection, trusted authorization-source semantics, or the prohibition on redundant confirmation requirements.
source_gap_claims.subject: Destructive-operation authorization and confirmation semantics
